patch: h2mux.go: CONNECT request carries Header: make(http.Header); h2mux_header_test.go added
digest_format: SHA256 of sorted UTF-8 lines: file-sha256 + two spaces + module-relative POSIX path + LF
reason: Go >= 1.27 with golang.org/x/net >= v0.54.0 selects the x/net/http2 wrapping implementation over net/http, which rejects a request whose Header is nil. Upstream h2mux built its CONNECT request without one, so every h2mux stream failed (client: 'http: nil Request.Header'; server hang). Upstream mihomo is unaffected only because it pins go 1.20 / x/net v0.35. Drop this copy once upstream sing-mux sets the header.
